title: Omni-Workspace: Benchmarking Omni-Modal AI Assistants on Multimodal Workspace Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.19202v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omni-modal agents are expected to move beyond multimodal understanding toward completing complex tasks in realistic multimodal environments. In these settings, information is distributed across heterogeneous files and modalities, with cross-file and cross-modal dependencies requiring agents to continually coordinate perception, reasoning, and tool use as newly gathered evidence informs subsequent actions. However, existing omni-modal benchmarks primarily focus on multimodal perception and understanding, leaving complex task completion through sustained interaction with multimodal workspaces underexplored. We introduce Omni-Workspace, a benchmark comprising 380 deep-research-style tasks across four multimodal workspace types and two difficulty levels. These tasks require agents to inspect and process workspace files, retrieve external information when needed, integrate evidence across files and modalities, and produce artifacts satisfying

translated_title: Omni-Workspace：在多模态工作区任务上评测全模态AI助手
translated_abstract: 全模态智能体有望超越多模态理解，在真实的多模态环境中完成复杂任务。在这些环境中，信息分布在异构的文件和模态之中，跨文件和跨模态的依赖关系要求智能体持续协调感知、推理与工具使用，因为新收集的证据会影响后续行动。然而，现有的全模态基准主要关注多模态感知与理解，对于通过与多模态工作区持续交互来完成复杂任务这一方向仍缺乏充分探索。我们提出了Omni-Workspace，这是一个包含380个深度研究风格任务的基准，涵盖四种多模态工作区类型和两个难度级别。这些任务要求智能体检查和处理工作区文件，在需要时检索外部信息，整合跨文件和跨模态的证据，并生成满足……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Omni-Workspace基准，包含380个深度研究风格的任务，用于评测全模态AI智能体在与多模态工作区持续交互中完成复杂任务的能力，填补了现有基准仅关注多模态感知与理解的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Omni-Workspace, a benchmark of 380 deep-research-style tasks for evaluating omni-modal AI agents on completing complex tasks through sustained interaction with multimodal workspaces, addressing the gap where existing benchmarks focus only on multimodal perception and understanding.
